name: VirtuaFOIL: Lakkurna Cove
summary:
VirtuaFOIL: Lakkurna Cove is a flat-water hydro-foiling/foil-boarding experience that places you in the heart of the enchanting "Lakkurna Cove". Fictionally known for its epic sunsets and perfect, crystalline waters, Lakkurna is also home to a reclusive fishing community said to keep guard over the Cove's more magical spots.  Impress the locals and gain access to every area within this 500-meter cove.
